# Collapsible

> Accessible disclosure primitive with measured open and close motion.

This file matches the installed `collapsible` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/collapsible.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/collapsible.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/collapsible-knobs`: `collapsibleKnobs`, types `CollapsibleKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/collapsible`: `Collapsible`, `CollapsibleTrigger`, `CollapsibleContent`, types `CollapsibleProps`, `CollapsibleTriggerProps`, `CollapsibleContentProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Collapsible>
  <CollapsibleTrigger />
  <CollapsibleContent />
</Collapsible>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/collapsible";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveCollapsibleExample() {
  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CollapsibleTrigger>
        <ChevronRightIcon />
        Reasoning steps
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent>
        <div className="mt-1 space-y-1.5 px-3 py-1">
          <Text as="p" tone="muted">
            Parsed the request and grouped the constraints.
          </Text>
          <Text as="p" tone="muted">
            Checked each candidate against the contract.
          </Text>
          <Text as="p" tone="muted">
            Kept the smallest change that satisfied all of them.
          </Text>
        </div>
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `collapsible`
  - `content`: `data-state` (`closed` | `open`)
  - `root`: `data-state` (`closed` | `open`)
  - `trigger`: `data-panel-open`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### collapsible

- `--cui-collapsible-trigger-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-collapsible-trigger-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-collapsible-trigger-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-collapsible-trigger-padding-block`: `0px`
- `--cui-collapsible-trigger-font-size`: `var(--text-label)`
- `--cui-collapsible-trigger-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-collapsible-trigger-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
